about_the_game:
Gambetto is a game combining rogue-like deckbuilding and the rule of chess. The game is about improve your deck strategically and win encounters with smart moves.

Big-Brain Combat!

In a 5x5 board, you and the AI will take turn to do actions, the goal is to capture the opponent's king. Planning ahead and react to what the opponent throws at you. Build up your board with careful placements and movements! And win the award to improve your deck!

Improve Your Deck!

Encounter different shop, awards along the way, improve your deck with card of interesting effect and synergy. Each character has their own special card pool, use your imagination to build the strongest deck!

... And much much more!!!

The game is still under development, so there are still quite a few features along the way, that includes:

  • Unlocking new cards and factions when you done enough runs or finished special achievements.

  • Special challenges with unique modifiers.

  • Difficulty modifiers that are prepared for the boldest, smartest challengers.
